additional_info.subject: RE: ID0375159-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R4 313059181001] Charger without function CRM:01410000977
additional_info.body:
Hi Emre,
I believe this is a new charger you were trying to commission today.
As
FC12
was on and you can measure voltage, however the devices from FC13 - FC17 was not on was there can be the following issue :
1) Pre Conditioning : Temperature or Humidity check. If the pre-conditions are not met, the charger heater will operate or if it was too hot the FAN will turn on.
Did you observe the operation of heater?
Was it running?
What was the temperature or humidity on the day of commissioning?
Can also be because of a defective temperature or humidity sensor.
2) FC13 - FC 17 , was manually switched Off. Did you check the state of FC13-FC17, have you already tried to manually switch ON them.
3) QA25 not operating : You need the check the KF10 operation, the supply to QA25 is from the Q4 of KF10.
Please let us know, if the above information are good enough for you to plan another site visit, or you need further details. When will you or the service team will be onsite to commission the charger?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Sharma

Hi Emre,
My colleague Saurav along with Furkan performed a site intervention today on the charger. It is understood that 24V was not seen at the -QA25 from the KF10 logo. Replacing the -KF10 LOGO with a spare one resolved the issue temporarily.
We will transfer the case back to RC-TR queue and we request you to provide us with the site report for further proceeding.
